opening.argument: BitWhistle is presented as a free Telegram service that monitors exchange spreads and sends arbitrage alerts. The description calls it a bot for automatic spread monitoring and offers viewers personal arbitrage signals for free. A trading chart beside sample alert messages shows what the service provides, while the description invites viewers to use the bot or join its communities. These are the elements of a signal-service promotion: the viewer is invited to receive alerts, not asked to invest with the operator or provide credentials. The evidence supports that narrower reading without establishing what results anyone obtained from the signals.
